name: Unplug – Site Add-On Optimizer
author: Mulberry Tech

sections.description:
Unplug helps you analyze and optimize your WordPress add-ons. Identify unused add-ons, measure performance impact, and safely remove bloat to boost your site’s speed and security. Perfect for inherited websites and plugin audits.

External services

This plugin connects to the Mulberry Tech licensing API to validate and manage plugin licenses. This service is used to verify license keys, check for updates, and manage license activations/deactivations.

The plugin sends the following data to https://mulberrytech.ca/api/license/:
– License key (when validating, activating, or deactivating)
– Plugin version information
– Basic site information for license validation

Data is sent when:
– Validating a license key in the plugin settings
– Checking for plugin updates
– Activating or deactivating a license

Service provided by Mulberry Tech:
– Terms of Service: https://mulberrytech.ca/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://mulberrytech.ca/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/unplug directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Unplug menu in the WordPress admin to access plugin features.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Complete WordPress Plugin Check PCP compliance
  • Fixed all database caching issues with wp_cache_get() and wp_cache_set()
  • Resolved all unescaped output functions (__(), _e(), ucfirst())
  • Added proper nonce verification for all $_POST and $_GET usage
  • Replaced unsafe print_r() with var_export() and proper escaping
  • Enhanced security with comprehensive output escaping
  • Improved performance with intelligent database query caching
  • Fixed malformed escaping functions throughout admin interface

1.2.9

  • Complete WordPress coding standards compliance
  • Fixed all unescaped translation functions
  • Added missing translator comments for placeholders
  • Enhanced security with proper output escaping
  • Improved internationalization support

1.2.5

  • UI/UX improvements, tab memory, deduped API token, scan results enhancements
